description: Source file defining the MPSHooks class for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) integration in PyTorch, including device management, memory, profiling, and event handling.

classes.name: MPSHooks
classes.description: Class providing hooks and interface for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) operations in PyTorch, including device, memory, profiling, and event management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes MPS devices and streams (placeholder).

methods.name: hasMPS
methods.description: Checks if MPS is available.

methods.name: isOnMacOSorNewer
methods.description: Checks if running on macOS or newer versions based on major and minor version numbers.

methods.name: getMPSDeviceAllocator
methods.description: Returns the MPS device allocator.

methods.name: getDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Returns the default MPS generator for a given device index.

methods.name: getNewGenerator
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MPS generator.

methods.name: deviceSynchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the default MPS stream.

methods.name: commitStream
methods.description: Commits the current MPS stream.

methods.name: getCommandBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the command buffer from the default MPS stream.

methods.name: getDispatchQueue
methods.description: Returns the dispatch queue from the default MPS stream.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Empties the MPS allocator cache.

methods.name: getCurrentAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns current allocated memory in MPS.

methods.name: getDriverAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns driver-allocated memory in MPS.

methods.name: getRecommendedMaxMemory
methods.description: Returns recommended maximum memory for MPS.

methods.name: setMemoryFraction
methods.description: Sets the high watermark ratio for MPS memory management.

methods.name: profilerStartTrace
methods.description: Starts profiling trace with specified mode.

methods.name: profilerStopTrace
methods.description: Stops profiling trace.

methods.name: acquireEvent
methods.description: Acquires an MPS event, optionally with timing.

methods.name: releaseEvent
methods.description: Releases an MPS event.

methods.name: recordEvent
methods.description: Records an MPS event.

methods.name: getDeviceFromPtr
methods.description: Gets device info from a pointer.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for an MPS event.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes an MPS event.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries the status of an MPS event.

methods.name: elapsedTimeOfEvents
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two MPS events.

methods.name: isPinnedPtr
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is pinned for MPS.

methods.name: getPinnedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Returns the pinned memory allocator.
